Visit note | 2025-07-08 10:00 AM | Dr. Sadia Islam, Dermatology | Patient: Abul Chowdhury, 28, male. Mr. Chowdhury returns for review, mentioning his itch is worse in humid weather and he has a rash with spreading edges. He states the trouble began during the humid monsoon in Tangail. He works as a CNG auto-rickshaw driver and has a history of Bronchial asthma. He denies fever, pain elsewhere, or blistering.
